title: Furstenberg's x2 x3 conjecture on invariant measures
exact_target: Must a jointly ergodic circle measure preserved by both doubling and tripling be either uniform or concentrated on finitely many points?

sources.citation: P. Burton, J. Panangaden, 'Formulations of Furstenberg's x2 x3 conjecture in complex analysis and operator algebras', arXiv:2410.22701 (2024).
